annotations.title: Get Nasdaq Pending Suspension / Delisting List

description: Issuers on Nasdaq's "Issuers Pending Suspension/Delisting" list as Signal8 last read it (read every 5 minutes, 4:00 a.m. to 7:55 p.m. ET on weekdays): symbol, company, stated suspension effective date, status, reason and Form 25 date, plus the changes recorded in the last changesDays (added, removed, date_changed, status_changed, form25_added). It answers questions such as which Nasdaq stocks have a scheduled suspension and whether a ticker is on that list. lastReadAt is the as-of; fresh says whether that read is current. A symbol leaving the list is not a cure (it also leaves when the suspension takes effect). measured=false means not measured, never "not on the list".

changesDays.description: Window for recorded changes, in days (default 7, max 90).

ticker.description: Only this symbol (its row and its changes).

name: get_pending_suspension_list
